platform_independence.principle: Wissenswerk is specified through open repository contracts, CLI JSON, tool manifests, and MCP-compatible adapters. IDE-specific files are generated adapters only.

capabilities.setup_profile: Create quick or guided project profiles for local-history demos and production projects.
capabilities.ragprep_import: Import prepared source corpora, register source documents, and normalize RagPrep evidence segments without duplicating parsing logic.
capabilities.corpus_analysis: Build corpus inventory, entity registry, claim ledger, concept graph, source coverage, and conflict candidates.
capabilities.article_planning: Prioritize typed article candidates before wiki generation.
capabilities.wiki_build: Compile type-specific Markdown pages and per-article provenance JSON from article plans and claims.
capabilities.audit_stats: Inspect generated pages, provenance, source leaks, conflicts, and demo statistics.
capabilities.demo_publish: Run an inspectable one-command demo pipeline and prepare GitHub Pages publishing without remote side effects.
capabilities.retrieval: PostgreSQL pgvector default with OpenAI-compatible embedding endpoints.
capabilities.providers: OpenAI-compatible chat, summary, embedding, and rerank profiles.
capabilities.automation: Auto-apply wiki generation with reports, provenance, and rollback hints.
capabilities.curation: Legacy alias surface for article-planning compatibility.
capabilities.doctor: Run platform-neutral contract, provider, design, and hygiene checks.
capabilities.reset_wipe: Dry-run-first reset and wipe planning for memory, indexes, generated state, wiki output, and tenant state.
capabilities.signals_tasks: Local JSON-first coordination layer for anomalies, blockers, handoffs, approvals, audit findings, and run events.
capabilities.bot: Discord adapter over the same Retriever/search interface.

memory.rule: facts come from sources, wiki, provenance, and retrieval; chat history and optional memory providers are not factual authority
